sources.entry: Paca - AI-native project management platform where AI agents and humans collaborate as Scrum teammates on the same board and sprints. Configurable via config files and WASM plugins (alternative to Jira, Trello, ClickUp and Monday). (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: Paca is a self-hosted, Apache-2.0 project management platform (Scrumban boards, sprints, backlog) where AI agents and humans work as Scrum teammates.
summary.what_it_does: Paca provides a shared Scrumban board, sprints, backlog, epics, stories, tasks, and project documents, with humans and AI agents assigned to the same work. Agents can pick up tasks, write BDD (Gherkin) specs, and contribute System Design Documents, and there is in-app AI chat at the project level. An event-driven automation engine lets users build trigger, condition, and action flows, with run history. Behavior is configurable through project-level config files, and functionality can be extended with WASM backend plugins and frontend module plugins, installed from a Plugin Marketplace in the UI or from the filesystem. It also ships an MCP server (@paca-ai/paca-mcp on npm) and Claude Code/Gemini CLI/Cursor slash-command skills for managing the workspace. Deployment is via an install script with Docker Compose, or a Helm chart for Kubernetes.
use_cases: run scrum sprints with AI agents on the team
self-hosted alternative to Jira or Trello
manage backlog, epics, and stories with an AI assistant
write BDD scenarios and design docs with agents
connect Claude or other MCP clients to a project board
how_to_run: curl -fsSL <install script URL> | bash  (interactive install, Docker required, Linux server)
PACA_YES=1 bash <install script> for non-interactive install
helm install paca oci://ghcr.io/paca-ai/charts/paca --version <tag> -n paca -f my-values.yaml  (Kubernetes)
npx -y @paca-ai/paca-mcp  (MCP server, requires PACA_API_KEY and PACA_API_URL)
notable: AI agents are first-class Scrum team members, assigned to sprints and board tasks alongside humans
Plugins compiled to WASM with capability-based permissions, plus frontend modules and a Plugin Marketplace
Each AI agent runs in its own isolated sandbox container
IAM-style role policies (allow/deny on resources) in v0.19.0
Supports ACP coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) via a local bridge
caveats: Installer and MCP setup require a running instance with API keys; the README describes a Linux-with-Docker install path and a Helm chart for Kubernetes
Helm chart requires secrets (jwtSecret, adminPassword, encryptionKey) with no defaults
Some AI features rely on external providers or bring-your-own keys (for example Jev AI with a user-supplied key)
The README's 'Thank-You' section mentions a partner signup perk; this is not part of the software and is not summarized here
